stem: What is one way that Kicking4Hunger is different from the Care Bags Foundation?

options.label: F
options.text: Kicking4Hunger accepts donated items to give to communities in need.

options.label: G
options.text: Kicking4Hunger focuses on meeting the needs of the children in a community.

options.label: H
options.text: Kicking4Hunger needs a leader to decide how best to support a community.

options.label: J
options.text: Kicking4Hunger provides training in exchange for donations to help the community.
